Discover Your Strengths Shape Your Future



Our network brings together licensed therapists, comprehensive mental health programs, and personalized care services to ensure every individual receives the guidance and support they need







At IGNITING BUSINESS YOGA WITH AI, we are dedicated to empowering individuals to discover their strengths,with scientific psychometric tests, ignite their passion, with Global Business Innovation Awards competition, celebrate creativity, entrepreneurship, and transformative solutions and build a successful future.





Through our 12-dimension psychometric evaluation Test and The E 2I eris analysis comprehensive psychomatric test , we help students, professionals, and aspiring entrepreneurs identify their unique abilities and choose the right pathway for personal and professional growth with our complete hand holding ecosystem.

We are committed to creating the world’s largest AI-powered venture studio for talent transformation, entrepreneurship, and skill development. We combine evidence-based assessments, expert mentorship, and practical skill-building programs to ensure meaningful outcomes for every participant. The platform will provide an end-to-end learning and career ecosystem that supports:








Psychometric Assessments for aptitude and career guidance.

C-Suite/CXO service & Investor Dashboards for governance, transparency, and impact analytics

Learning Pathways including courses, skill development, entrepreneurship, and internships.





Career Counseling to provide personalized career recommendations.

Certification & Job Placement to validate outcomes and connect students with employers.
